name: German Health Insurance Number (KVNR)
description:
Detects German statutory health insurance numbers (Krankenversicherungsnummer, KVNR). Format: 1 uppercase letter (initial of birth name) followed by 9 digits. Checksum uses GKV alternating-factor Luhn; validator omitted pending hardcoded implementation for letter-to-ordinal substitution.

Format: A123456789 — 1 letter + 9 digits (10 effective digits after A=01..Z=26 substitution)
Official name: Krankenversicherungsnummer (KVNR)
Note: GKV checksum requires letter substitution to 2-digit ordinal before Luhn calculation; validator omitted pending hardcoded implementation

effect.message: German health insurance number tokenized for de-identification
